method: Three samples per side in A/B/B/A/A/B order, each a direct npm run build plus PWA7/7. Same installed node_modules junction, package.json LF-equivalent. Original baseline lock retained; only fast-uri3.1.8->3.1.9 and serialize-javascript7.0.6->7.1.4 differ, both builds use the same patched installation and all other lock nodes must be identical. All frontend inputs except node_modules/dist frozen after diagnostic declaration generation. Actual emitted JS import/export AST closure and every precache URL/non-null MD5 checked. gzip9 sums are not browser transfer or interaction measurements.

environment.workload: No known test/build process overlapped the six final builds. Host load, caches and path/EOL differences uncontrolled; build times are observations only.

Original baseline lock security nodes differ from the shared patched installation by the two explicitly verified patches. This isolates source changes on one toolchain; it does not prove byte equivalence to a previously deployed artifact.
